label: 🌀 아이누 모레우 — 30대 측면 비틀기
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot.
Model: one woman in her thirties, hourglass figure, narrow waist and rounded hips, long dark hair loose over one shoulder.
Pose: hips in full profile at 90 degrees to the camera, torso rotating forward so the chest opens toward the lens and one breast reads frontal, shoulders squared to the camera, one arm extended down along the thigh, the other lifted to the collarbone, head facing the lens directly.

Body fully painted with: Ainu attus appliqué and embroidery — the entire body covered in continuous flowing curvilinear pattern with no plain ground. Interlocking moreu spiral scrolls and ayus thorn-hook barbs in indigo navy and off-white, each band edged with fine chain-stitch outlines, the scrolls looping and branching without repeating, dense enough that navy and white share the surface evenly. Uniform density from collarbone to ankle — no panel, no band structure, no garment shape.

Pigment applied directly on bare skin, matte, pores and skin texture visible.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in ONE thin crisp border; hands and feet bare.
Hands fully visible, five separated fingers each. Nails long coffin-shaped, lacquered deep indigo navy.

Footwear: pale birch-wood platform wedge sandals, sculptural block form, open toe with painted toenails visible.
Environment: a pale wood gallery interior, one attus robe mounted flat behind.
Lighting: cool key from the front left at 45 degrees, raking across the rotated torso to define the bust and waist, soft rim from behind right.
Style: high fashion editorial meeting textile craft. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 2:3 vertical.
